text: Owner request 2026-09-15: rename intent-factory to Faberun everywhere, move the source to the repository root keeping history, add installer + self-updater + release-please, replace internal docs with user-facing ones (vision, concepts, manual, getting started, ADRs, README), add first-run onboarding that detects harnesses and asks which to use, give the CLI its own identity (hornero nest, five-colour palette, DESIGN.md), keep the skills as CLI features with the agent kit optional, and run all of it as a campaign of the tool on itself.

Campaign, run, phase and node ids say what the work is (become-faberun-2-cli-product, brand-and-banner), never only when it ran; the owner asked for this after seeing p1/p2 ids. Recorded in the skill's workflow reference.

The controller runs from an immutable git archive of 597e282 under .runs/control/become-faberun/controller/ and drives the four contracts through supervise campaign, promoting each run onto campaign/become-faberun; the orchestrator lands that branch on main at the end. Workers never run git mv or npm install; history is preserved by rename detection.

Preflight found gpt-5.6 refused for a ChatGPT-account Codex and gpt-5.6-sol exhausted until 2026-09-19 09:44, so no codex runtime is routed: structural and prose nodes run on dsh-deepseek-pro (deepseek-v4-pro, fallback zcode-glm-pro), mechanical nodes on dsh-deepseek-flash (fallback agy-gemini-flash), every node judged by claude-opus-judge. The campaign was re-initialized twice before any run because manifest digests freeze the contracts; both re-inits are recorded here and cost nothing.

docs/history, docs/campaigns and evals/golden are never edited (a contract records what a worker was told); the contract protocol version stays 0.3.0 as CONTRACT_VERSION; the [ok]/[warn]/[fail] line grammar keeps its text; no implicit network calls in the CLI; the main checkout is not edited while a run is active.

The chain parks the campaign on any failure and nothing clears campaign.attention; node campaign-unpark in contract 2 adds the way back. Until it lands, a parked chain is recovered by resuming the run and clearing attention by hand, recorded as a decision note.

supervise campaign launched run 1 and parked the campaign on its next tick with contract_digest_mismatch: chain.mjs digests the validated contract while run-identity records the digest of the raw authored file, so a chained campaign parks after every first launch. Run 1 keeps running under its own controller with supervise --detach as watchdog. For this campaign the chain is operated by hand: promote each succeeded run onto campaign/become-faberun with promoteRunInCampaign, launch the next contract with run --detach --base-ref, and add a chain-digest-fix node to contract 2 so the tool leaves the campaign with a working chain and a test that exercises the real digest path.

Owner instruction 2026-09-15 (mid run 1): workers always use deepseek-flash, never deepseek-v4-pro. Run 1 attempt on dsh-deepseek-pro was canceled and its run directory, worktree, branch and refs removed so the run id is reused; every contract now routes every node to dsh-deepseek-flash (fallback agy-gemini-flash) with claude-opus-judge judging. The chain's stale parked attention was cleared by hand at the same time.

rename-to-faberun attempt 1 hit stall_timeout (15 min silent) and was auto-retried from its sealed worktree. Attempt 2's worker found that the dsh worker environment carries GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2 with GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0/1 but no GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0/1, so every git init in a test fails with status 128 inside the worker; the variables come from the Claude Code shell that launched the controller (credential.interactive/guiPrompt=false) and dsh drops the KEY half. The controller's own verification env is complete and unaffected. Every later launch in this campaign unsets GIT_CONFIG_* first; the dsh adapter should scrub or complete that family (follow-up finding for the retrospective).

Run 1 (move-and-rename) done: 2 nodes, 3 attempts, USD 2.18, about 72 min. The tree lives at the root, 460 files moved with git rename detection, package faberun, zero live occurrences of the old name (ratchet test/repo/brand.test.mjs), full suite + tsc + both evals green as final verification. Judge findings (all minor, recorded): evals/README.md historical sentence lost its literal; the managed block payload had historical run ids rewritten (self-heals on the next signal sync); README install lines read mechanically (phase 4 rewrites README); two runner.mjs strings remain in src/campaign/index.mjs:113 and src/web/index.html:211 (orchestrator fixes at landing). Promoted onto campaign/become-faberun at ca2977a.

At landing, orchestrator fixes in one docs commit: DESIGN.md banner ceiling says 64 columns but its own sample line is 67 (judge finding on brand-and-banner; set the ceiling to 72 and keep the drawing); evals/README.md historical sentence that lost its literal (reword without the old name); the two leftover runner.mjs user-facing strings (src/campaign/index.mjs:113, src/web/index.html:211) if no node fixed them.

Owner instruction 2026-09-15: Faberun is also an npm package and the name faberun is reserved there. The name is free (E404 on npm view). Contract 3's release-pipeline node now adds a publish-npm job to release-please.yml (gated on release_created, npm publish --provenance --access public through npm trusted publishing / OIDC, no token secret) plus publishConfig.access public; contract 3's getting-started and contract 4's README name npm install -g faberun and npx faberun. The reservation itself is an orchestrator npm publish of 0.3.0 from the landed phase-1 tree once the owner runs npm login in this session; the one-time trusted-publisher configuration on npmjs.com is the owner's step after that publish.

Run 2 (cli-product): 7 of 8 nodes done and integrated at 0e03f62 (brand-and-banner in 2 attempts, self-update, skills-verb, setup-onboarding, init-repository, campaign-unpark, chain-digest-fix all pass), USD 6.10. The phase-terminal node install-script failed its final verification: test/repo/source-shape.test.mjs found a raw spawnSync("git", ["--version"]) in src/cli/setup.mjs:278 that setup-onboarding's own verification never ran, and install-script could not repair a file outside its scope. Canceled before the doomed second revision. Follow-up contract become-faberun-2b-install-and-shape-fix: one-line fix routing the probe through boundedGitSync, then install-script again, based on 0e03f62; the land branch advances only when that run's full final verification passes.

Run 2b: bounded-git-in-setup done (one-line fix, no judge); install-script exhausted after two rejections, USD 1.03. Attempt 1 was correct but its candidate verification died: node --test test/engine/ received SIGKILL at 93 s -- the engine signals -pgid of a recorded pid without an identity check, and macOS recycles pids within minutes (the same defect surfaced as kill EPERM crashing the drive loop in seal-before-kill.test.mjs when run standalone on this tree). Attempt 2 was rejected on a real major finding: install.sh repointed current with ln + mv -f, which follows the existing symlink and moves the temporary link into the version directory, so upgrades were no-ops. Follow-up contract become-faberun-2c-guard-and-install: stale-group-signal-guard (ownership proof before any group signal, EPERM never propagates, verification children record start tokens) then install-script with ln -sfn and an upgrade test, based on 2b's tip fcad2d4.

Run 2c: stale-group-signal-guard stalled twice (stall_timeout at 8 and 10 minutes of silence) and install-script was blocked behind it; canceled. The work itself was complete after attempt 1 (sealed 4c7f237: process-identity.mjs with invocationOwned, EPERM/ESRCH never propagate, tokens for verification children, darwin ps retry, 64 new test lines) and the node's own verification command passes in 51 s when run outside the sandbox. The worker never reported done because the dsh workspace-write sandbox cannot signal other processes or run ps, so the termination tests it was told to run hung until the executor's 10-minute cap. Lesson for every future packet: a dsh worker must not run tests that signal or probe processes; the controller's verification is the proof. Follow-up contract become-faberun-2d-guard-review-and-install is based on 4c7f237: a review node that only runs tsc and source-shape itself, then install-script.

Run 2d: guard-review done (empty diff; the sealed guard was accepted with two minor findings -- no test observes a product-recorded token, and supervise.mjs terminateControllerGroup still signals on liveness alone, now a node in contract 3). install-script attempt 1 was correct (sealed 091949b, ln -sfn, upgrade test) but the phase's final verification failed in test/campaign/field-ownership.test.mjs: the guard's invocation_identity_unverifiable event writes pid and processGroupId to events.jsonl and docs/FIELD-OWNERSHIP.md was never updated -- a scope the guard packet should have carried (writeFiles lists what the change forces to change). Canceled before the doomed second revision; USD 1.09. Follow-up become-faberun-2e based on 091949b: install-review (light, reviews the sealed installer) then field-ownership-declaration as the terminal node carrying the full suite.

Run 2e: install-review pass (installer reviewed, empty or minimal diff) and field-ownership-declaration done with the full suite, tsc and both evals green as the phase-2 final verification; USD 1.06. Phase 2 (cli-product) is complete across runs 2, 2b, 2c, 2d and 2e: brand-and-banner, self-update, skills-verb, setup-onboarding, init-repository, campaign-unpark, chain-digest-fix, bounded-git-in-setup, stale-group-signal-guard, install-script, field-ownership declaration. Promoted onto campaign/become-faberun at 0d834b2. Phase-2 cost about USD 9.9 across five runs; the three re-runs were paid for by (1) a raw git spawn outside the setup node's own verification, (2) the pid-recycling signal defect, (3) a writeFiles omission (FIELD-OWNERSHIP.md) in the guard packet.

npm: faberun@0.3.0 published by the owner from the phase-2 landing tip (0d834b2) on 2026-09-16T02:04:55Z -- 144 files, 1.5 MB unpacked, bin faberun with setup, init, update, skills and the installer. The name is reserved; release-please will publish 0.4.0 and later through the publish-npm job once the owner configures the trusted publisher on npmjs.com (package faberun -> Settings -> Trusted publisher -> GitHub Actions, owner feliperun, repository faberun, workflow release-please.yml).

docs-index attempt 1 (documentation only) was rejected because the candidate's full test/engine/ run failed 'the judge re-ask bound survives a controller crash in either gap because it is persisted with the node' (AssertionError: the controller persisted the re-ask verdict before the blocked transition) while the same suite passed in the attempt worktree minutes earlier. The test asserts an ordering between persisting the re-ask verdict and the blocked transition that the code does not guarantee under load; it is a flake in test/engine (judge.test or judge-gate.test), unrelated to the node's work. Attempt 2 is a plain retry. Candidate for a follow-up node: make the persistence ordering deterministic or make the test await the persisted record instead of racing it.

Run 3 (docs-and-releases): 6 nodes done, USD 7.54. supervisor-group-guard pass (terminateControllerGroup now proves ownership through the lock token); release-pipeline pass on attempt 2 (judge caught Node 22's npm lacking OIDC trusted publishing and the husky prepare hook running on publish: Node 24 + --ignore-scripts); command-manual pass (docs/COMMANDS.md + two-way command-surface test); vision-and-concepts and getting-started-and-adrs accepted with minor accuracy findings (moved to contract 4's docs-accuracy node); docs-index pass on attempt 2 after a flaky judge.test.mjs re-ask ordering assertion failed the first candidate. Full suite, tsc and both evals green as the phase's final verification. Promoted onto campaign/become-faberun.

Run 4 (front-door): skill-references pass, docs-accuracy done (one minor wording finding left for the landing commit), readme-front-door done on attempt 3 -- attempt 1 lost the phase's full suite to a load-sensitive seal-before-kill assertion, attempt 2 returned blocked_context asking for engine test files after reproducing sandbox-only failures, and the orchestrator answered through resume --answer; the README (156 lines: hornero hero, badges, positioning, install/npm/contributor routes, quickstart, how it works, harness table, docs map, development, history, licence) then landed with the full suite green. USD 1.47. Promoted onto campaign/become-faberun. All four phases are complete; landing on main follows.

Campaign become-faberun, 2026-09-15 21:10 UTC to 2026-09-16 04:20 UTC (about 7.2 h): the repository became Faberun through 8 runs, 27 node instances (22 done), 36 attempts and 60 provider invocations -- 34 worker turns on dsh-deepseek-flash (1.90 M input, 1.06 M output, 67.6 M cache-read tokens, unpriced: dsh reports no cost and the runtime declared no pricing) and 26 judge turns on claude-opus-5 (USD 20.47). Landed on main at 5373df1: 499 files changed, +7407/-1590 over 32 commits, full suite + tsc + both evals green. Delivered: the tool at the repository root with history intact and zero live occurrences of the old name (ratchet test); package and command faberun, npm faberun@0.3.0 published by the owner; DESIGN.md identity implemented (brand module, banner, coloured check tokens); faberun --version, update (GitHub Releases, verify-before-switch), skills verb, setup (requirements + harness discovery + config that composition honours), init (.runs, skill, optional agent kit), install.sh; campaign unpark; release-please with npm trusted publishing; docs/ (VISION, CONCEPTS, COMMANDS with a two-way surface test, GETTING-STARTED, ARCHITECTURE, ADR 0001-0006, map) and a new README. Five real defects of the factory surfaced and were fixed by the campaign itself: (1) supervise campaign parked every chained campaign on its first tick (chain digested the validated contract, the run recorded the stored one) and nothing could unpark -- chain-digest-fix and campaign-unpark; (2) the engine signalled -pgid of recycled pids without identity proof, seen as kill EPERM crashing the drive loop and as a SIGKILL of a sibling test run -- process-identity.mjs invocationOwned, start tokens for verification children, EPERM never propagates; (3) the supervisor's terminateControllerGroup had the same gap -- fixed in phase 3; (4) a raw spawnSync(git) slipped past a node's own verification -- caught by the phase final verification, fixed by a one-line node; (5) FIELD-OWNERSHIP.md omitted the guard's new events.jsonl fields -- a writeFile…
